query: 负责任营销政策 负责任营销政策 衡量企业营销活动在真实性、透明度、社会价值引导及弱势群体保护方面的规范程度。重点考察预防误导宣传、保护未成年人、广告审查流程及违规问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的负责任营销准则；包含明确的“禁误导/夸大”红线；针对未成年人或其他弱势群体有专项保护机制；设有独立的多级内容审查流程（如合规或法务会签）；具备明确的虚假宣传违规问责与纠偏机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的广告管理制度或包含在员工行为准则中，具备基础的真实性要求和法务审核环节，但缺乏针对未成年人等特定群体的保护细节或系统的问责逻辑。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“诚信经营”等口头表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：负责任营销政策覆盖 >80% 的产品线、业务单元、销售地区及所有营销渠道（含新媒体、直播、线下广告）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对大众传播而忽略了经销商、KOL 推广等私域场景，或未披露覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 负责任营销 广告规范 禁止误导宣传 未成年人保护 营销合规审查 广告审批 虚假宣传问责 responsible marketing advertising standards misleading claims protection of minors marketing compliance review advertising approval false advertising accountability 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '负责任营销政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“诚信经营”口号；仅有产品标签合规说明；仅有品牌传播案例；仅有客户隐私政策；区分：负责任营销规范宣传内容与受众保护；产品标签关注包装说明书信息披露；二者都涉及真实性，但场景与载体不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Material Issues / Raise Awareness of Prevention
results.text: During the Reporting Year, the Group was fined approximately RMB490,000 by the Jilin Municipal Administration of Market Supervision for failing to advertise the school district in accordance with the public announcement of the Jilin Municipal Education Bureau and the Urban Planning Bureau in 2019. In this regard, the Group has enhanced the approval procedures for external publicity and street advertisements, and set up a WeChat group for online screenshots and joint audits to provide advice on making any amendments.

Material Issues / Raise Awareness of Prevention

[Content]
During the Reporting Year, the Group was fined approximately RMB490,000 by the Jilin Municipal Administration of Market Supervision for failing to advertise the school district in accordance with the public announcement of the Jilin Municipal Education Bureau and the Urban Planning Bureau in 2019. In this regard, the Group has enhanced the approval procedures for external publicity and street advertisements, and set up a WeChat group for online screenshots and joint audits to provide advice on making any amendments.

results.section: Material Issues / Excellent Services and Products
results.text: The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. Employees from Hong Kong and Mainland China can refer to 'Employee Handbook' of the Hong Kong office and the 'Employee Relations management Methods' of the Mainland China offices respectively as all relevant requirements in different regions are listed in them. In addition, the Group has implemented firewalls, behavioural analysis tools, anti-virus software, and encrypted all files to enhance network security and protect customer data. The Group reviews its cybersecurity regularly and has formulated a contingency plan that sets out procedures and guidelines for responding to and handling cybersecurity incidents such as cyberattacks that may threaten its business.

Material Issues / Excellent Services and Products

[Content]
The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. Employees from Hong Kong and Mainland China can refer to 'Employee Handbook' of the Hong Kong office and the 'Employee Relations management Methods' of the Mainland China offices respectively as all relevant requirements in different regions are listed in them. In addition, the Group has implemented firewalls, behavioural analysis tools, anti-virus software, and encrypted all files to enhance network security and protect customer data. The Group reviews its cybersecurity regularly and has formulated a contingency plan that sets out procedures and guidelines for responding to and handling cybersecurity incidents such as cyberattacks that may threaten its business.

results.text: The Group is committed to operating its business with honesty, ethics, and integrity to ensure fair competition throughout its business operations. The Group adopts a zero-tolerance attitude towards any form of corruption, including bribery, extortion, fraud, and money laundering, and has established policies, such as the 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work System', 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work Guidelines', 'Intendance and Audit System', 'Tendering Management Methods' etc., stating the Group's expectations and demands towards our employees and cooperation partners. In addition, the Group implements 'Implementation Rules for Separation of Incompatible Positions' to reduce the risks of corruption and fraud under the principles of horizontal check and balance and vertical restriction. Each party should perform their respective duties and responsibilities under the mutual restraint to reduce the risk of corruption and fraud.

Material Issues / Anti-corruption

[Content]
The Group is committed to operating its business with honesty, ethics, and integrity to ensure fair competition throughout its business operations. The Group adopts a zero-tolerance attitude towards any form of corruption, including bribery, extortion, fraud, and money laundering, and has established policies, such as the 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work System', 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work Guidelines', 'Intendance and Audit System', 'Tendering Management Methods' etc., stating the Group's expectations and demands towards our employees and cooperation partners. In addition, the Group implements 'Implementation Rules for Separation of Incompatible Positions' to reduce the risks of corruption and fraud under the principles of horizontal check and balance and vertical restriction. Each party should perform their respective duties and responsibilities under the mutual restraint to reduce the risk of corruption and fraud.
